scripture.verse: "And I beheld and, lo, in the midst of the Throne and of the four living creatures and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth. And He came and took the book out of the right hand of Him that sat upon the Throne."

sermons.title: Sermon 2096 | The Marriage of the Lamb

scripture.verse: "Let us be glad and rejoice and give honor to Him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come and His wife has made herself ready. And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints."
"But He knows the way that I take: when He has tried me, I shall come forth as gold."

sermons.title: Sermon 2099 | Concerning the Consolations Of God

scripture.verse: "Are the consolations of God too small for you? Is there any secret thing with you?"

sermons.title: Sermon 2100 | Faith Essential to Pleasing God

scripture.verse: "But without faith it is impossible to please Him: for he that comes to God must believe that He is and that He is a Rewarder of them that diligently seek Him."
"And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, has He quickened together with Him, having forgiven you all trespasses."

"Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ. Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?"'Acts 2:36-37.

sermons.title: Sermon 2103 | The Hunger and Thirst Which Are Blessed

scripture.verse: "Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled."
